constraints: 1<=T<=30;1..100lines/message;1..30words/line;ASCII letters;word<=30;whitespace separators;skip shortword without advancing index;reset perline.
independentMethod: Queue of remaining words: for wanted position1,2,... discard short candidates until one qualifies, then consume that word; independent of decoded-length reference.

mutations.label: Advances index even when word is short
mutations.replace: int index = 0; while (input >> word) { if (word.size() > size_t(index)) decoded.push_back(word[index]); ++index; }
